column3: ECS/Fargate, RDS PostgreSQL, ElastiCache Redis, S3, CloudFront.
column4:
• All AWS services provisioned in correct region (GCC/ME)
• RDS PostgreSQL accessible only from ECS security group
• Redis accessible only from ECS security group
• S3 bucket configured with correct access policies
• CloudFront CDN serving static assets correctly

column3: GitHub Actions → staging and production environments.
column4:
• Push to main branch deploys to staging automatically
• Production deployment requires manual approval
• Secrets managed via GitHub Secrets — no plaintext in repo
• Failed deployments trigger alert

column3: Redis-based daily job to freeze skip/switch operations.
column4:
• Job runs at exactly 18:00 server time daily
• Monitoring alert fires if job runs late or fails
• API endpoints enforce lock independent of cron
• Lock status visible in admin dashboard

column3: Firebase project, WhatsApp Business API, webhook config.
column4:
• FCM credentials configured for both iOS and Android
• WhatsApp Business API approved and live
• Webhook endpoint reachable from Twilio
• Test notification delivered successfully in staging

column3: Full QA pass across all user flows and edge cases.
column4:
• All subscription state transitions tested: NEW→ACTIVE→PAUSED→EXPIRED
• 6 PM lock tested — skip and switch rejected after cutoff
• Payment sandbox tested with success and failure scenarios
• Push notification delivery confirmed on iOS and Android
• EN and AR layouts tested on physical devices
• All API error states return correct status codes and messages

column3: Client UAT round with bug fix and regression re-test.
column4:
• Client has access to staging environment for UAT
• All critical and high bugs fixed before go-live
• Regression test run after each bug fix batch
• Go-live checklist signed off by both parties
